an10.107:1.1: Atthi bhikkhave dakkhiṇesu janapadesu dhovanaṃ nāma.
an10.107:1.2: Tattha hoti annam pi pānam pi khajjam pi bhojjam pi leyyam pi peyyam pi naccam pi gītam pi vāditam pi.
an10.107:1.3: Atth' etaṃ bhikkhave dhovanaṃ, n' etaṃ natthī ti vadāmi.
an10.107:1.4: Tañ ca kho etaṃ bhikkhave dhovanaṃ hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati.
an10.107:2.1: Ahañ ca kho bhikkhave ariyaṃ dhovanaṃ desissāmi, yaṃ dhovanaṃ ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati; yaṃ dhovanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti, jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti, maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti.
an10.107:2.2: Taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī ti.
an10.107:2.3: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an10.107:3.1: Katamañ ca taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ dhovanaṃ, yaṃ dhovanaṃ ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati; yaṃ dhovanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti, jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti, maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti? 3.
an10.107:4.2: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, te c' assa niddhotā honti,
an10.107:4.3: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
an10.107:5.1: Sammāsaṅkappassa bhikkhave micchāsaṅkappo niddhoto hoti . . . pe . . .
an10.107:6.2: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, te c' assa niddhotā hoti,
an10.107:6.3: sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti. 4.
an10.107:6.4: Idaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ dhovanaṃ, yaṃ dhovanaṃ ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati; yaṃ dhovanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti, jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti, maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccantī
